Question Choices: Select. A baker makes 84 cookies in 4 hours. How many cookies does the baker make per hour? : 21cookies-per-hour 84cookies-per-hour 4cookies-per-hour
Hints: Rate = amount per something (per hour, per item, etc.)
Solution: Unit rate = total ÷ time = 84 ÷ 4 = 21 cookies per hour

Question Choices: Class A has 7 tables, there are 4 students per table. Class B has 6 tables, there are 5 students per table. Which class has more students? Answer A or B
Hints: Find students in each class then compare
Solution: Class A has 7 x 4 = 28 students. Class B has 6 x 5 = 30 students. B has more

Question Choices: A cyclist rides 66 km in 3 hours. How far will the cyclist travel in 5 hours?
Hints: First find the rate (km per hour)
Solution: Rate = 66 ÷ 3 = 22 km per hour. 5 hours = 22 x 5 = 110 km

Question Choices: A store sells 8 pens for 12 dollars. How much would 10 pens cost?
Hints: Find the rate (price per pen) first.
Solution: Price per pen = 12 ÷ 8 = 1.5 dollars. 10 pens = 1.5 x 10 = 15 dollars

Question Choices: Three runners run different speeds. Runner A runs 12 km in 3 hours. Runner B runs 10 km in 2 hours. Runner C runs 9 km in 1.5 hours. Who runs the fastest? Answer A or B or C
Solution: A: 12 ÷ 3 = 4 km/h. B: 10 ÷ 2 = 5 km/h. C: 9 ÷ 1.5 = 6 km/h. C is the fastest
